================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO MŌ AFTER EFFECTS - HE AHA TE HOU
Putanga 9.2.9  -  Oketopa 2026
================================================================================

Kua hono mai ngā ĀHUA ANIME hou 33 ki ērā o Demon Slayer, ka tino kitea ināianei ngā pānga
kiore o ngā āhua i roto i After Effects, ā, kotahi noa te rārangi taka mārama o te Kōwhiri Kaupapa.

I MUA I TE TĪMATA
- Tāutahia ki runga i tō putanga o ināianei mā tāu kaitāuta ZXP e whakamahi ai i ngā wā katoa,
  ā, tīmata anōtia a After Effects kia kotahi te wā.
- Ka mau tonu āu tautuhinga, tō āhua, ō tautuhinga tōmua me ō kīanga kua tiakina.

HOU: 33 ĀHUA ANIME
- Kei Ngā Tautuhinga Flex > KŌWHIRI KAUPAPA > KAUPAPA PANELA ināianei he rōpū kotahi mō ia anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) me Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- He āhua motuhake tō ia tangata: te mea e whai ana i tō kiore, te whakaeke ina
  pāwhiria e koe tētahi pātene, te mea ka puta i te wā e pupuri ana koe i te pātene mauī, me te
  pahū i muri i te pupuri mō te 2.5 hēkona pea.
- He māmā pērā i ngā āhua Demon Slayer: ka rere noa ngā pānga i te wā e neke ana, e pāwhiri ana
  rānei koe. Whakawetohia NGĀ PĀNGA TAIAO kia toe noa ai ngā tae.

KUA WHAKAREREKĒ: KŌWHIRI KAUPAPA
- Kua ngaro ngā kāri Demon Slayer i raro i KAUPAPA PANELA, nō reira kua poto ake
  Ngā Tautuhinga Flex. Kōwhiria ia āhua i te rārangi taka KAUPAPA PANELA; ka tuwhera ia
  ki te āhua e whakamahia ana e koe.
- Kei te rōpū Naruto ināianei a Kurama rāua ko Baryon.

KUA WHAKATIKAHIA
- He maha ngā wā kāore i kitea ngā pānga kiore o ngā āhua (te wai, ngā mura, te uira me ērā atu)
  i roto i After Effects, ahakoa i weto te Aratau Arotau. Ko ngā wā pukumahi o te papa
  tonu, me te tīmatanga pukumahi, i pōhēhētia he āhua pūhoi, nō reira i whakaweto ngā
  pānga i a rātou anō. Ināianei, ina tuhia rātou e tō kāri whakairoiro (te nuinga o ngā
  rorohiko), ka whakamāmā noa aua wā i ngā pānga mō te wā poto.

KĀORE I REREKĒ
- Ka mahi pēnei tonu te raihana, te whakahohe me ia hono pēnei i mua.
- He ōrite tonu ngā āhua Demon Slayer 11 ki ērā o te 9.2.8.
- Ka mahi pēnei tonu ētahi atu ripa me ngā taputapu katoa pēnei i te 9.2.8.
================================================================================
